headline: EPS climbs both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Japan Securities Finance reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥48.44, up 32.7% q/q and up 68.3% y/y.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥48.44 rose 32.7% sequentially from ¥36.49 and 68.3% year-over-year from ¥28.78. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
